access_logs.list.title: List access logs
access_logs.list.description: List access logs page by page: every operation call of the caller’s side with its result, duration and client; filter by time range, trace, user, session, operation, result and status code.
access_logs.get.title: Get access log
access_logs.get.description: Get an access log of the caller’s side.
exception_logs.list.title: List exception logs
exception_logs.list.description: List exception logs page by page: unhandled exceptions of the caller’s side with type, message and location.
exception_logs.get.title: Get exception log
exception_logs.get.description: Get an exception log of the caller’s side, including the full stack trace.
login_logs.list.title: List sign-in logs
login_logs.list.description: List sign-in logs page by page: sign-in, refresh, sign-out, tenant switch, impersonation and password change events of the caller’s side, successful or not.
login_logs.get.title: Get sign-in log
login_logs.get.description: Get a sign-in log of the caller’s side.
operation_logs.list.title: List operation logs
operation_logs.list.description: List operation logs page by page: audited business operations of the caller’s side with their results and durations.
operation_logs.get.title: Get operation log
operation_logs.get.description: Get an operation log of the caller’s side, including its details.
diff_logs.list.title: List data change logs
diff_logs.list.description: List data change logs page by page: entity inserts, updates and deletes of the caller’s side.
diff_logs.get.title: Get data change log
diff_logs.get.description: Get a data change log of the caller’s side with field-level before and after values.
permission_change_logs.list.title: List permission change logs
permission_change_logs.list.description: List permission change logs page by page: grants, revocations, role membership, data scope and edition changes of the caller’s side.
permission_change_logs.get.title: Get permission change log
permission_change_logs.get.description: Get a permission change log of the caller’s side.
condition_hits.list.title: List condition hits
condition_hits.list.description: List condition hits page by page: access policy and permission condition hits of the caller’s side.
condition_hits.get.title: Get condition hit
condition_hits.get.description: Get a condition hit of the caller’s side.
open_api_logs.list.title: List open API logs
open_api_logs.list.description: List open API logs page by page: signed open API calls of the caller’s side with their signature checks.
open_api_logs.get.title: Get open API log
open_api_logs.get.description: Get an open API log of the caller’s side.
traces.timeline.title: Trace logs
traces.timeline.description: Aggregate the logs of the caller’s side by trace, user, session or client address into one timeline, oldest first, with counts per log type.

my_login_logs.list.title: My sign-in logs
my_login_logs.list.description: List your own sign-in logs page by page (sign-in, refresh, sign-out, tenant switch, impersonation, password change and more, successful or not), newest first, up to 50 per page.
my_activity.summary.title: My activity
my_activity.summary.description: Your activity: sign-ins, accesses and operations today, this week and this month, the latest of each, and daily operations and accesses over the last 371 days, split by the requested time zone.
auditing.time_zone.invalid: The time zone '{timeZone}' is not valid.
